status_reason: Only 7 full years (2019-2025) are available, fewer than the 5-year baseline plus 10-year swing the report uses.
name: Average bus speed
definition: Average speed of MTA local, limited, Select Bus Service and express buses in New York City, in miles per hour: total bus miles divided by total operating hours across all routes and months.

latest_extra.note: Same calculation for January-October; January-October 2025 was 8.31 mph.

source.name: MTA Bus Speeds (data.ny.gov cudb-vcni, 'MTA Bus Speeds: Beginning 2015')

method: For each calendar year with all 12 months: sum of total_mileage divided by sum of total_operating_time over every route, borough, trip type (local/limited, Select Bus Service, express), day type and peak/off-peak period. This weights each route-month by its operating hours (equivalently, it is total bus miles over total bus hours), rather than averaging route speeds. The borough breakdown applies the same formula within each borough.
caveats: The dataset is titled 'Beginning 2015' but its rows start in January 2019, so there is no earlier history from this source.
The dataset's column descriptions for mileage and operating time are swapped; the values (and the dataset's own average_speed field) confirm mileage divided by hours gives mph.
